name: Turboroko: Passion Fever
source:
Step into 'Fallen Wonderland' the mysterious remains of a lost civilization held as a beacon of hope for humanity.

From sunken city streets to technologically violated wastelands, the world has changed.

All is seemingly well before a series of horrific events begin to transpire in increasingly drastic levels.

The discovery of a corpse has become the catalyst for a journey of self discovery for you and your friends.

The weight of the world is on your shoulders. 

Will you be able to help them find all the answers in life?

[From [url=https://marsye0.itch.io/turboroko-passion-fever]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
走进“堕落仙境”，这里是失落文明的神秘遗迹，它是人类希望的灯塔。

从沉没的城市街道到技术破坏的荒地，世界已经发生了变化。

一切似乎都在一系列越来越严重的可怕事件开始发生之前发生。

尸体的发现已成为你和你的朋友自我发现之旅的催化剂。

世界的重担都压在你的肩上。

你能帮助他们找到生活中所有的答案吗？

[来自[url=https://marsye0.itch.io/turboroko-passion-fever]itch.io[/url]]
